_docs.domain.broker_default_cfg: fallback policy used when the policy file is missing
_docs.domain.priority_groups: groups scheduled ahead of everything else
_docs.endpoints.channels: channels shown by the status views (local plus worker ports)
_docs.endpoints.default_registry: fallback worker registry used when the registry file is missing; empty = none
_docs.endpoints.default_worker: worker base URL used when --worker is omitted; empty = the flag is required
_docs.endpoints.generation_patterns: header markers naming a writer generation, most preferred first
_docs.endpoints.object_suffix: only keys ending in this are treated as transfers
_docs.endpoints.preferred_tags: key substrings worth preferring, most preferred first
_docs.endpoints.prefix_template: key layout inside the store; placeholders: prefix, build, flavor. Change it here rather than in code
_docs.endpoints.s3_base: base URL of the object store the manifest points into; empty = not configured
_docs.endpoints.tag_probe_pattern: substring that marks a usable record in an object header; site-specific
_docs.identity.driver: name of this driver instance; it selects the state and control files, so two drivers must not share one name
_docs.identity.owner: owner label attached to submitted requests
_docs.ops.local_lines: local lines; only used when there are no remote lines
_docs.ops.record_ledger: write a ledger record per finished file; needs the ledger module, which is a separate chain and not part of this package
_docs.ops.stage_high_gb: staging usage above this pauses new work
_docs.ops.stage_low_gb: drain to this level before resuming
_docs.ops.stage_max_file_gb: files larger than this bypass staging
_docs.ops.win_connections: connections per transfer on the remote path
_docs.ops.win_gate: remote lines wait for this sentinel file to appear; empty = start now
_docs.ops.win_gate_max_wait: longest wait for the sentinel, in seconds
_docs.ops.win_lines: remote lines at startup; the control file overrides this at runtime
_docs.ops.worker_port_cap: concurrent transfers allowed per worker port; each transfer opens its own connections on top of this
_docs.paths.alerts_file: append-only alert stream; three env names accepted, first non-empty wins
_docs.paths.data_roots: extra roots scanned by the "already on disk?" check; outdir and outdir_alt are always included
_docs.paths.manifest: CSV listing the items to fetch: one row per item, columns name/key/group/tier/build/tag_status  [required]
_docs.paths.manifest_alt: optional second CSV holding direct URLs; empty = that source is skipped entirely
_docs.paths.notify_spool_dir: spool directory for completion notices; empty = notifications off
_docs.paths.outdir_alt: root directory for secondary transfers; empty = same as outdir
_docs.paths.outdir_template: where one finished item lands, relative to a root; placeholders: outdir, group, tier, name, key
_docs.paths.shared_roots: subset of the roots that other writers also touch: a file there is only trusted once its container trailer is intact
_docs.paths.stage_dir: staging root on fast local storage; empty = write straight to the destination
_docs.tools.hole_scanner: program that reports zero-filled regions inside a file
_docs.tools.integrity_checker: program run on a finished file to verify it; empty = the transfer-time checks are all that ran, and that is said
_docs.tools.range_patcher: program that re-fetches a byte range in place
_docs.tools.s3_prefix_downloader: prefix downloader used for the object-store channel
_docs.tools.status_collector: optional hook run after each completed transfer
_docs.tools.stream_checker: program that dumps container headers/records, used to probe a remote object before fetching it
_docs.tools.tailscale_bin: tailscale executable; give a full path when it is not on PATH
_docs.tools.tailscale_sock: tailscaled socket path, needed in userspace-networking mode

_note: Template site configuration. Copy to ~/.config/download-worker/site.json (or point DL_SITE_CONFIG at it) and fill in your own values. Only deployment-specific values belong here; the operational knobs under ops.* can be left out and the built-in defaults will apply.
